schema:
CREATE TABLE projects (project_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_title TEXT, state TEXT);
CREATE TABLE allocations (alloc_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, used_funds REAL, total_funds INTEGER, project_ref TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (project_ref) REFERENCES projects (project_code));
correct_query: SELECT T2.project_title FROM allocations AS T1 INNER JOIN projects AS T2 ON T1.project_ref = T2.project_code WHERE T2.state = 'Completed' ORDER BY T1.used_funds / T1.total_funds DESC, T1.alloc_code NULLS LAST, T2.project_code NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
